description: Endorsements from both groups reflects Senator Kupec’s record of fighting for Minnesota agricultureMOORHEAD, MN — Senator Rob Kupec is proud to announce endorsements from both the Minnesota Farmers Union and Minnesota Farmers Bureau, two of the state's largest farming advocacy groups. The rare endorsement from both groups, which often differ ideologically, is a clear demonstration of the confidence in Kupec’s work to strengthen Minnesota’s agriculture economy and deliver results for farmers.Kupe
